text.tspan: Where Helm keeps a release: one Secret per revision
Inside (tested keys): apply_method, chart, config, hooks, info, manifest, name, namespace, version
the OLD input of the next
No Tiller since Helm 3: the cluster itself holds the history. --history-max (default 10) = how many revision Secrets are kept.
Never put passwords in values: use External Secrets or Sealed Secrets.
